mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST( COALESCE(p.planned_recruit, 0) - COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sis.student_id) FROM student_internship_status sis WHERE sis.position_id = p.id AND sis.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND COALESCE(sis.recall_status, 0) != 2 ), 0), 0 )), 0) FROM position p WHERE p.status = 'active' AND (p.internship_end_date IS NULL OR p.internship_end_date >= CURDATE())
